requirements.requirement: The system must parse eligibility criteria text into distinct inclusion and exclusion sections when both are present.
The system must count the number of exclusion criteria items identified in the eligibility text.
The system must detect and count demographic restrictions including age, sex, and geographic limitations.
The system must identify medically complex conditions (e.g., comorbidities, lab thresholds, prior treatment history) within eligibility criteria.
The system must assign higher strictness weight to exclusion criteria than inclusion criteria when computing the score.
The system must compute a normalized strictness score between 0 and 1 based on parsed eligibility features.
The system must produce consistent strictness scores for identical eligibility input text across repeated executions.
The system must expose the scoring logic as a reusable function within clinical_trials_service.py.
The system must handle eligibility text with only inclusion or only exclusion criteria without failure.
The system must return a default strictness score when eligibility criteria text is empty or null.
The system must gracefully handle malformed or unstructured eligibility text without raising an unhandled exception.
The system must use NLP or pattern-based parsing to extract criteria rather than relying solely on exact string matches.
The system must detect negation patterns (e.g., "no prior treatment", "must not have") when identifying exclusion criteria.
The system must differentiate between soft recommendations and hard eligibility constraints when parsing criteria.
The system must cap the strictness score at 1.0 even when extreme numbers of restrictions are present.
The system must assign a lower strictness score to trials with minimal or broadly inclusive eligibility criteria.
